services.title: Workflow automation
services.problem: Manual handoffs, copying between tools, repetitive admin, brittle spreadsheets and recurring tasks that depend on someone remembering the next step.
services.response: Map the process, remove unnecessary steps, connect APIs and systems, and build the smallest reliable automation or internal tool that closes the loop.

services.title: Internal AI systems
services.problem: Knowledge scattered across documents, repetitive operational questions, manual research and unstructured inputs that are expensive to process by hand.
services.response: Build controlled AI-assisted workflows with explicit sources, validation and human decision points instead of a generic chatbot pasted onto the process.

services.title: RevOps & data automation
services.problem: CRM operations, recurring reporting, manual data manipulation and disconnected systems that make operational decisions slower than they should be.
services.response: Create pipelines, synchronisation, automated reporting, enrichment and decision-support surfaces that reduce recurring operational load.

services.title: AI / process opportunity audit
services.problem: A team knows it should use AI or automation but does not yet know where the economics, data and workflow constraints make it worthwhile.
services.response: Map processes, identify repeatable pain, rank opportunities by value and feasibility, then prototype the strongest candidate before committing to a larger build.

engagement.title: Diagnose
engagement.text: Understand the workflow, users, constraints and where time or quality is actually being lost.

engagement.title: Prototype
engagement.text: Test the smallest technically honest solution against real inputs before scaling scope.

engagement.title: Ship
engagement.text: Build the integration, data path, interface and failure handling needed for regular use.

engagement.title: Handover
engagement.text: Document the system, expose the important controls and make ongoing operation understandable.
